name: Necrodominance
oracle_text:
Skip your draw step.
At the beginning of your end step, you may pay any amount of life. If you do, draw that many cards.
Your maximum hand size is five.
If a card or token would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay any amount of life. If you do, draw that many cards.

needs.what: a mid-resolution optional payment of a player-chosen amount of life (0..current life total, 119.4) on `may`, binding the amount paid so a following `draw` reads it -- i.e. `may` with `pay: {"pay_life": 1}` and `any_amount: {"as": "paid"}` (or a `pay_life_x` honoured by `may`'s `x`)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `may.any_amount` accepts only one coloured/{C} mana symbol or `pay_energy: 1`; `may.x` announces an X over mana (`_announce_x` probes mana sources), and `pay_life_x` is honoured only as a spell's additional cost at cast time; `choose_number` takes a constant integer `max`, so it cannot be bounded by the life total and a `may` paying `{"binding": n}` life would be a capped or over-offering approximation
